title: Service Ad Without Source Assets
tests: Creates a coherent app ad without supplied assets, visibly demonstrating the service instead of requiring screenshots.

faults.what: The demo contains blurred, garbled interface labels and task text rather than readable tasks and scheduling information.
Cards shift and disappear, but the messy board never resolves into a clearly organized daily plan.
The supplied frames are approximately 1.64:1 rather than the requested 16:9.
The ending places ClearDay in a large gray rectangle over the cluttered interface, making the end card feel unfinished.
The sound report identifies speech despite the request for silence, although the reported peak of -76.3 dB is extremely quiet.

judge.summary: The blue-and-white demo ends with a readable ClearDay title, but its garbled interface and shifting cards do not demonstrate a clear daily plan.

must_haves.item: The final video is 8 seconds long and landscape 16:9.
must_haves.why: The clip is reported as 8 seconds, but the supplied landscape frames are approximately 1.64:1, not 16:9.

must_haves.item: A created app demo visibly changes from a messy task list into an organized daily plan.
must_haves.why: A created interface is visible and cards change position, but no readable, organized daily schedule emerges.

must_haves.item: The visual design is predominantly blue and white with a calm presentation.
must_haves.why: The interface uses pale blue and white throughout with a restrained presentation.
The final supplied frame prominently displays the exact name.
The supplied sound report identifies speech, though its reported peak level is extremely low.
